description: User names policy in Turn 1 and uses pronoun 'it' in Turn 4 to ask for deductible.

turns.user_message: Hi, I have an Optima Care Health Insurance policy with number POL-OC-88219.
turns.ground_truth_target: Optima Care Health Insurance policy POL-OC-88219

turns.user_message: Are ICU charges covered under this policy?
turns.ground_truth_target: Clause 2.2 covers ICU charges up to actuals under Plan B or 2% sum insured under Plan A.

turns.user_message: And what is the pre-hospitalization coverage duration?
turns.ground_truth_target: Clause 2.3 covers up to 60 days prior to admission.

turns.user_message: What is the deductible on it if I chose voluntary cost sharing?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Optima Care Clause 4.1, voluntary deductible options are ₹10,000 or ₹25,000 per policy year.

description: User states car engine size in Turn 1. Turn 2 asks for compulsory deductible, which requires engine CC.

turns.user_message: I drive a 2023 sedan with a 1600 cc petrol engine under SecureDrive Motor policy MOT-SD-40192.
turns.ground_truth_target: SecureDrive Motor Policy MOT-SD-40192 with 1600 cc engine.

turns.user_message: If I get into an accident, how much compulsory deductible will I have to pay out of pocket?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Motor Clause 4.1, private cars exceeding 1,500 cc have a compulsory deductible of ₹2,000 per claim.

turns.user_message: What about towing expenses to the nearest garage?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Motor Clause 1.5, towing expenses are covered up to ₹1,500.

turns.user_message: How many hours do I have to submit written notice of accidental loss?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Motor Clause 6.1, notice must be given within 48 to 72 hours of the incident.

description: User originally states city as Mumbai, then corrects it to Bengaluru. Ombudsman question must use Bengaluru.

turns.user_message: My health policy number is POL-OC-11204 and my residence is in Mumbai.
turns.ground_truth_target: Registered location: Mumbai

turns.user_message: What is the claim settlement timeline if all my bills are submitted?
turns.ground_truth_target: Clause 6.6 mandates settlement within 30 days of last document receipt.

turns.user_message: Wait, please note that I relocated from Mumbai to Bengaluru last month.
turns.ground_truth_target: Updated registered location: Bengaluru

turns.user_message: If the insurer delays my claim, which Insurance Ombudsman office has territorial jurisdiction for my complaint?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under IRDAI Annexure R Clause 10.1, the Bengaluru Ombudsman Office has jurisdiction for Bengaluru residents.

description: Discusses health insurance, switches to car NCB bonus, then returns to health post-hospitalization bills.

turns.user_message: I hold an Optima Care health policy POL-OC-99381. How long do I have to submit hospital bills?
turns.ground_truth_target: Clause 6.3 requires bills to be submitted within 30 days of discharge.

turns.user_message: Switching topics: my friend has car insurance. What is the NCB discount after 3 claim-free years?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Motor Clause 4.3, 3 consecutive claim-free years earns a 35% No Claim Bonus.

turns.user_message: And if they make a small claim, does NCB become zero?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Motor Clause 4.3, lodging a claim resets NCB to Nil (0%) unless NCB protection add-on exists.

turns.user_message: Returning to my own health policy: how many days of post-hospitalization follow-up medical bills can I claim?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Optima Care Clause 2.4, post-hospitalization medical expenses are covered up to 180 days.

description: User stated pre-existing hypertension in Session S05_A. In new Session S05_B, asks about waiting period.
prior_session_facts: User diagnosed with chronic hypertension in 2021 (pre-existing condition on health policy POL-OC-33100)

turns.user_message: Hello, I am continuing from my conversation last week about my Optima Care health policy POL-OC-33100.
turns.ground_truth_target: Optima Care Policy POL-OC-33100.

turns.user_message: What is the waiting period for pre-existing diseases under this policy?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Clause 3.3, pre-existing diseases carry a mandatory 36-month waiting period.

turns.user_message: Given my high blood pressure condition that I told you about earlier, is it eligible for claim yet?
turns.ground_truth_target: Recalling user diagnosis of hypertension in 2021: since more than 36 months have elapsed, pre-existing hypertension is now admissible under Clause 3.3.

turns.user_message: Are routine diagnostic blood pressure checks covered under domiciliary hospitalization?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Clause 2.6, domiciliary hospitalization excludes routine outpatient checkups and cough/cold.

pattern: Claim Reference Number Tracking Across Turns
description: User files a claim reference number in Turn 1, then asks for status and required documents in later turns.

turns.user_message: I lodged a reimbursement claim under reference CLM-2024-8831 for my Optima Care policy.
turns.ground_truth_target: Claim reference CLM-2024-8831 recorded.

turns.user_message: The insurer sent an inquiry letter. Are they allowed to send multiple staggered query letters?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under IRDAI Clause 2.1, piecemeal queries are prohibited; all queries must be raised in a single communication within 15 days.

turns.user_message: If they delay payment beyond 30 days after I reply, do they owe me interest?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under IRDAI Clause 2.4, the insurer must pay penal interest at 2% above the RBI bank rate.

turns.user_message: What is the maximum limit I can claim through the Insurance Ombudsman if this claim gets rejected?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under IRDAI Clause 3.3, disputes up to ₹30,00,000 can be submitted to the Ombudsman.

description: User discusses accidental damage to car, asks for Constructive Total Loss threshold, and salvage value.

turns.user_message: My car insured under SecureDrive policy MOT-SD-77192 met with a severe highway accident in Pune.
turns.ground_truth_target: Policy MOT-SD-77192 registered in Pune.

turns.user_message: The garage estimated repair cost at ₹4,00,000 on an IDV of ₹5,00,000. Is this a Constructive Total Loss?
turns.ground_truth_target: Yes. ₹4,00,000 is 80% of IDV, which exceeds the 75% threshold in Motor Clause 1.4 for Constructive Total Loss.

turns.user_message: Can I retain the damaged car salvage myself?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Master Circular Clause 15.4, the insured may retain salvage with a mutually agreed deduction from IDV.

turns.user_message: Since this happened in Pune, can a surveyor survey it via video call since loss is high?
turns.ground_truth_target: No. Under Motor Clause 6.3 and 15.3, claims exceeding ₹50,000 require an independent physical surveyor inspection.

description: User received policy electronically, asks about free look cancellation days and refund rules.

turns.user_message: I purchased an Optima Care health policy POL-OC-55021 online 10 days ago.
turns.ground_truth_target: Policy POL-OC-55021 purchased online 10 days ago.

turns.user_message: Can I still cancel it under the free-look period?
turns.ground_truth_target: Yes. Under IRDAI Clause 1.1, policies obtained electronically or via distance marketing have a 30-day Free-Look Period.

turns.user_message: What deductions will the insurer make from my refund?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Clause 1.1, deductions include proportionate risk premium, medical examination costs, and stamp duty.

turns.user_message: How will they send the money and within how many days?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Master Circular Clause 16.1, refund must be credited via direct bank transfer (NEFT) within 7 business days.

description: User reports car stalled in flooded underpass, asks about engine repair coverage.

turns.user_message: I have car insurance MOT-SD-33910. My car got stuck in water during heavy rains in Delhi.
turns.ground_truth_target: Policy MOT-SD-33910 in Delhi.

turns.user_message: I tried restarting the engine in the water and now it won't crank. Is internal engine repair covered?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Motor Clause 5.7, damage caused by hydrostatic lock from attempting to restart is excluded under base cover.

turns.user_message: What add-on cover would have covered this damage?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Schedule M Clause 9.2, the Engine and Gearbox Protector Add-on covers water ingression and hydrostatic lock.

turns.user_message: Is roadside towing covered to take it out of the underpass?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Motor Clause 1.5, towing is covered up to ₹1,500 (or up to 50 km if Roadside Assistance add-on was active).

pattern: Senior Citizen Age and Deductible Interaction
description: Inquires about coverage for 65-year-old parent under Optima Care health policy.

turns.user_message: I am managing health policy POL-OC-66190 for my father who is 65 years old.
turns.ground_truth_target: Policy POL-OC-66190 for 65-year-old insured.

turns.user_message: Does he have to bear any mandatory co-payment on hospitalization claims?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Clause 4.2, a compulsory 10% co-payment applies to all claims for insured persons entering at or after age 61.

turns.user_message: If his hospital bill is ₹2,00,000 and we also have a ₹10,000 voluntary deductible, how is the payout calculated?
turns.ground_truth_target: Deductible of ₹10,000 applies first (remaining ₹1,90,000), then 10% co-payment (₹19,000) is deducted, leaving net payout of ₹1,71,000.

turns.user_message: Is there any priority desk for fast-tracking his claim since he is a senior citizen?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Master Circular Clause 14.4, a dedicated senior citizen priority desk must process his claim within 15 days.

description: User gives wrong claim ID CLM-2024-1100, then corrects it to CLM-2024-9900 in Turn 3.

turns.user_message: I filed a claim under Optima Care POL-OC-44120 with reference CLM-2024-1100 in Kolkata.
turns.ground_truth_target: Claim CLM-2024-1100 in Kolkata.

turns.user_message: How many days does the insurer have to communicate their initial claim query?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under IRDAI Clause 2.1, initial queries must be raised in a single communication within 15 days.

turns.user_message: Wait, I made a typo! The correct claim reference is CLM-2024-9900, not 1100.
turns.ground_truth_target: Updated claim reference: CLM-2024-9900.

turns.user_message: Can you confirm which claim reference number is currently active on my profile?
turns.ground_truth_target: Active claim reference is CLM-2024-9900.

description: User states car age in Turn 1, then asks about depreciation on rubber vs glass vs metal parts.

turns.user_message: I own a 3-year-old car insured under SecureDrive policy MOT-SD-12099.
turns.ground_truth_target: Policy MOT-SD-12099 for a 3-year-old vehicle.

turns.user_message: If my windshield glass and front plastic bumper are broken, what depreciation applies to glass?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Motor Clause 1.2, all parts made of glass have Nil (0%) depreciation.

turns.user_message: And what depreciation applies to the plastic bumper and rubber hoses?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Motor Clause 1.2, rubber, nylon, plastic parts, and tyres suffer 50% depreciation.

turns.user_message: Since my car is 3 years old, what depreciation would apply to metal door replacement?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Motor Clause 1.2, metal parts for vehicles aged between 2 and 3 years have a 15% depreciation rate.

description: User ported policy with 24 months past credit. In new session, asks if cataract surgery is covered.
prior_session_facts: User ported from Star Health to Optima Care POL-OC-70011 with 24 months of accrued continuity credit

turns.user_message: I am checking my Optima Care health policy POL-OC-70011 which I ported recently.
turns.ground_truth_target: Ported policy POL-OC-70011.

turns.user_message: What is the specific disease waiting period for cataract surgery?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Clause 3.2, cataract surgery has a mandatory waiting period of 24 consecutive months.

turns.user_message: Considering the portability credits from my previous insurer on my profile, is cataract surgery eligible now?
turns.ground_truth_target: Yes. Recalling 24 months of accrued continuity credit under IRDAI Clause 1.4 and Clause 3.3, the 24-month cataract waiting period is fully satisfied.

turns.user_message: What is the monetary sub-limit per eye under Plan A?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Clause 4.3, cataract surgery under Plan A is capped at ₹40,000 per eye.

description: User was in a highway crash. Turn 4 asks if emergency dental surgery is covered despite dental exclusion.

turns.user_message: I suffered accidental injuries in a road traffic collision in Hyderabad under health policy POL-OC-66022.
turns.ground_truth_target: Accidental bodily injury reported under POL-OC-66022 in Hyderabad.

turns.user_message: Does the standard 30-day initial waiting period apply to my hospitalization?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Clause 3.1, the 30-day waiting period does not apply to accidental bodily injury.

turns.user_message: I was admitted to the hospital for 3 days and required maxillofacial and dental surgery for broken jaw bones.
turns.ground_truth_target: In-patient hospitalization for accidental dental/jaw surgery.

turns.user_message: Will the insurer reject my dental expenses citing the general dental exclusion?
turns.ground_truth_target: No. Under Clause 5.10, dental treatment is covered if requiring hospitalization following an accidental bodily injury.

description: User sold car with 50% NCB in past session. In new session, buys new car and asks to transfer NCB.
prior_session_facts: User sold previous car on 2023-11-10 with 5 claim-free years and holds an active 50% NCB Reserving Certificate

turns.user_message: Hello, I just bought a new car and took a SecureDrive policy MOT-SD-88001.
turns.ground_truth_target: New policy MOT-SD-88001.

turns.user_message: Can I transfer the No Claim Bonus from the old car I sold last year to this new car?
turns.ground_truth_target: Yes. Recalling user's 50% NCB Reserving Certificate, Motor Clause 4.4 and FAQ 12.5 permit transfer to a replacement vehicle purchased within 3 years.

turns.user_message: Does the 50% discount apply to the entire premium including third-party liability?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Motor Clause 4.3, NCB applies solely to the basic Own Damage (OD) premium, not to Third Party liability.

turns.user_message: What add-on can protect this 50% NCB if I lodge a claim next year?
turns.ground_truth_target: Under Motor Clause 4.3 and Schedule M, an NCB Protection Add-on preserves the bonus upon lodging a claim.
